countries.reasoning: China is the largest producer of calcium, mainly from calcium carbonate sources, based on USGS and mining industry data 2023; figures are well-documented and consistent.
The US has significant calcium production from lime and limestone with updated data from the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2023; slightly less than China but well tracked.
India is a major producer of calcium compounds, mainly from limestone, backed by national mining data and industry estimates from recent years.
Russia has a strong production base in calcium from mineral deposits; data is somewhat less comprehensive but consistent over last few years.
Mexico's calcium production from limestone is significant but data coverage is less complete and older, so confidence is moderate.
